comparison.objective: Unfold a laptop stand and seat both support rods in its highest-setting slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinating a passive scissor linkage and aligning two rods with separate slots.
comparison.success_condition: Stand fully spread, both rods seated at the highest setting, contained, released, and stable under the applicable spec.
comparison.reason: Both establish and verify an adjustable configuration, but this tests linkage deployment and discrete rod-slot insertion; it lacks coupled screw/jam-nut countertorque and preservation of a continuous stop setting through cycles.
